admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
Thursday group session - a change of time

Hello all, and sorry for the disruption. After some thought, the group steward has decided that from next week the Thursday group session will move from midday to early evening, and it will stay at that time for the rest of the season. We think the evening slot will probably suit most people better, but we know it may not suit everyone, and we are truly sorry if it is awkward for you. If the new time does not work, you would be very welcome at the Saturday drop-in instead. Please do send any questions to the steward - thank you for bearing with us.
